precise: placed by an ability in an unflagged leaf of 5 or more, plus the keyword block, “No abilities” and the replacement groups, out of the 33,183 in-scope cards
with_annotation: the with-tentative figure plus 960 pile cards with an annotated ability (condition not read) and no tentative placement
with_broad: the headline plus the 3,254 cards whose abilities sit only in groups broader than they look
with_gap_stratum: the with-annotation figure plus 160 pile cards whose only reading is an ability held by the gap test (card part not read); reported on its own line, never blended
with_tag: the with-annotation figure plus 1,205 of the 1,300 cards with no readable ability that sit in a community-tag group of 5 to 100 cards (browsable by community tag, not organized; not checked against the parse)
with_tentative: the broad figure plus 2093 not-yet-organized cards with an eligible ability in a tentative group

meta.label: Grouped by community tag. Not checked against the card's parsed text.

rules.scope: primary reason 'no readable ability' (remaining_cards.json), not tentative, not condition-annotated
